whyRepositoryQualifies: judg3d is an early-stage MIT-licensed acceptance gate for glTF/GLB asset pipelines. It combines Khronos validation with versioned budgets, explicit coverage and deterministic reports, usable through CLI, local UI and MCP. Its ecosystem contribution is giving humans and coding agents a reproducible external check of 3D outputs. I can demonstrate real pass/fail/infra cases; I am not claiming broad adoption yet.
apiCreditUse: I would use credits for maintainer-approved regression-test proposals, reproducer reduction, issue triage and release-note drafts. I would evaluate suggestions against deterministic fixtures and human review, with per-run and monthly spending limits. No automatic merges or release publication, and no private user assets sent without permission. judg3d itself remains usable without an API key or paid model.
additionalContext: I am the primary maintainer. The current implementation supports SCHEMA and PROFILE, not visual or semantic judging. A historical 78-round authoring project contains seven recorded judge runs; I do not present it as 78 validations or independent adoption. The repository includes a reproducible demo, security boundaries, regression tests and clean-install package checks. I would welcome feedback on the project's ecosystem fit.
